issue.title: Task-wikilink snapshot and ranking CPU budgets fail repeatedly on athena
issue.description:
Proposed by bob-cli-f5.3 #1 (warm snapshot and ranking) and bob-cli-f5.4 #1 (ranking); triaged by bob-cli-f5.land.

Clean bob-plugins 32c9e03248a03c1570f4dea6a29e7c8f6c15f130 on athena, Node v22.14.0, fails two nodes in scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-wikilink-index-performance.cjs in three unchanged runs: one combined focused run and two isolated node --test runs. Warm snapshot plus order measured 75.7, 82.9, 80.8 ms against 50 ms; one keystroke rank of 5,000 rows measured 12.5, 12.2, 12.9 ms against 12 ms. Phase f5.3 reported identical failures on its clean base as well. These two gates are currently repeatable in isolation, so this is filed as ci, not assumed to be a load-only flake.

The same file also had an intermittent cold-build chunk miss in the third run (16.4 > 16 ms); it passed the first two. Keep that observation with this performance investigation, without claiming the same root cause is proved.

Investigate and repair the TaskWikilinkIndex snapshot/order performance contract or its measurement. The tests ALREADY measure CPU time, warm the rank path, and take best-of 5/7 samples. Do not misdiagnose this as wall-clock scheduling or blindly increase budgets. Inspect the production snapshot/rank path, establish reproducible Node/host measurements, and preserve a test that detects real slowdowns. The performance test and block-id-prompt production code were untouched by f5. Test history: 4ef761a introduced the index coverage; f0c1c97 is its latest repair. No active epic in the current list causally owns this defect (eq is already closed).

This is distinct from closed bob-cli-3w: that task fixed cold process.hrtime measurement of navigation dependencyStageRank for 1,000 rows / 16 ms, a different ranker and file. Same-type/all-type searches and last-week sweeps found no task for the current CPU budgets. Size large because the underlying cost/measurement cause is not yet established and needs planning; do not silently redefine the production latency target.

Repro: node --test scripts/test-block-id-prompt-task-wikilink-index-performance.cjs
Evidence: file:explicit:3f28f3367c36f04929e7f6a0, file:explicit:e2d6e77a67e959ecb6b61bdb, file:explicit:59db89a083d8355365b792e0.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Both nodes failed in all three unchanged-tree runs, one combined and two standalone: snapshot 75.7/82.9/80.8 ms versus 50 ms; rank 12.5/12.2/12.9 ms versus 12 ms. Already CPU-timed, warmed, and best-of sampled. Cause not established; no passing rerun claimed.

issue.creation_reason: f5.3 and f5.4 proposed performance failures unrelated to task link marks. The lander reproduced both gates three times, including isolated runs; their cause requires investigation beyond f5.
